scope: Frozen before inspecting any successful official learned-policy rollout. The seven original short health attempts remain failures.
commands: Identical source-indexed, substep-resolved joint targets, velocities and generalized efforts. No fresh policy output, object force, source modification or mid-trajectory reset.
initialization: Build a new official Newton scene, solver and environment for each replicate. Explicit reset to source frame zero with virtual object assistance exactly zero, deterministic initialization, same model and contact material hypotheses.
pass: The original controlled attempt and both independent repeats must complete all original source intervals and individually pass the same position, rotation, stationary-object comparison, endpoint, lift, hand support in air, release, penetration, joint, and human hand tracking gates. A failed, missing or truncated source tail cannot qualify.
exact_state_metric: Preserve original frozen 1e-9 independent low-level replay state threshold, values and result in a separate field; continue to report original all-gates result unchanged.
solver_force_validation: A canonical physical-reproducibility claim also requires validated solver-load semantics and momentum balance for the same physics version and material configuration. Otherwise return provisional_unknown even if all three numeric trajectories pass.
report: All frame counts, per-replicate gate results and metrics, pairwise max and RMS object translation and angle differences, maximum generalized q and qd differences and replay-input checksums.
